editorial.blurb: TenGoku Aburiya delivers impressive sushi and grilled skewers with genuine warmth from a dedicated team.
editorial.insiderTip: Hit their happy hour for exceptional value on sushi and rolls, and arrive early or during off-peak times to avoid the notorious wait—service pacing can be inconsistent even when the restaurant isn't crowded.
signatureDishes: Udon with minced pork and fish
